llm_with_rag.answer_preview: ISO VG 46 anti-wear hydraulic oil maintained between 38 C and 54 C during continuous duty cycles.
Depressurize accumulator ACC-04 by opening manual bleed needle valve NBV-03 three full turns counterclockwise and confirming zero reading on gauge PG-MAIN.
Pump cavitation manifests as high-pitched metallic knocking above 82 dBA coupled with erratic ram advance speed.
Normal main cylinder working pressure is 21.5 MPa (3,118 psi).
